sources.claim: Trend Micro reports Ryuk ransomware distribution via TrickBot and BazarLoader.
Proofpoint says TA800 BazaLoader implants were reported as leveraged to distribute Ryuk ransomware.

curator_note: Modeled from the payload perspective: Ryuk was delivered through BazarLoader in documented ransomware initial-access activity.
confidence_reason: Trend Micro directly reports Ryuk distribution via BazarLoader, and Proofpoint corroborates BazaLoader use in Ryuk delivery context.
